name: Failure To Eval Loop
description: Capture a reusable agent-system failure and convert it into sanitized regression coverage.
approval_boundaries: Do not preserve secrets, private identifiers, or private repository paths in fixtures.
Do not encode one-off preferences as reusable requirements.

phases.name: Failure capture
phases.instructions: Separate expected and actual behavior and capture minimal reproduction context.

phases.name: Scenario design
phases.instructions: Define observable pass criteria, failure signals, fixtures, and maturity.

phases.name: Regression design
phases.instructions: Create minimal synthetic scenario artifacts and catalog metadata.

phases.name: Target review
phases.instructions: When applicable, review the failed skill or instruction surface for the smallest justified change.

phases.name: Workflow dry run
phases.instructions: Dry-run multi-phase changes and confirm boundaries and gates.

phases.name: Eval handoff
phases.instructions: Verify continuation context, validation, maturity, and next action.
